comparison_class.definition: Names announcing an incremental buyback authorization without any concurrent dilutive registration or covenant/litigation flag
comparison_class.why_this_class: closest analogue isolating a clean buyback authorization from confounding structural events

thesis: The expanded buyback authorization is the one structurally notable item in view; there is no dilutive registration, no covenant flag, and no litigation flag alongside it. The investor-day 8-K and the routine 10-Q carry no signal on their own. This is a low-conviction lean, not a strong call -- an authorization is not the same as execution, and pace/timing are entirely at management's discretion.

key_evidence.claim: Incremental buyback authorization, no offsetting dilution/covenant/litigation flags

what_would_change_my_mind: Evidence the buyback is not actually being executed, or a subsequent dilutive filing.
